name: South Dakota
agency: South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks

rule.textEn: South Dakota has no mandatory boater education. Age limits apply instead: 12 to run a motor over 6 hp alone and 14 for a PWC, unless an adult 18+ is aboard.
rule.textEs: Dakota del Sur no exige educación náutica obligatoria. En su lugar hay límites de edad: 12 años para manejar solo un motor de más de 6 hp y 14 para una moto acuática, salvo que vaya a bordo un adulto de 18 años o más.

minAge.note: Under 12: no motor over 6 hp unless someone 18+ is aboard. Under 14: no PWC of any horsepower unless someone 18+ is aboard. Owners may not let underage people operate.

pwcExtra: Minimum age 14 to operate a PWC alone; younger only with someone 18+ aboard.

sources.publisher: South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks
sources.quote: Although a boating safety course is not required to operate a boat in South Dakota, it is highly recommend that you complete a NASBLA/USCG approved course.

sources.publisher: South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks, 2023 Boating Handbook
sources.quote: Although boating education is not mandatory in South Dakota we continue to urge boaters to take an online boater education course.

sources.publisher: South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks, 2023 Boating Handbook
sources.quote: Operator under the age of 12 May not operate a motorboat propelled by a motor of more than 6 horsepower, unless a person 18 years or older is on board.

sources.publisher: South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks, 2023 Boating Handbook
sources.quote: Operator under the age of 14 May not operate a personal watercraft (PWC), of any of horsepower, unless there is a person 18 years or older is on board.

sources.publisher: South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks, 2023 Boating Handbook
sources.quote: South Dakota offers three certified online courses.
